title: Manage Undertaking Requirements
acceptance_criteria: 8.1.1 System shall list Controller Undertakings as one of the Lead Agencies for selection under the Lead Agency field.

8.1.2 System shall display the agency’s Undertaking requirements. There shall be a quick filter function to allow CRO(Undertaking) to choose the status, a. ‘All’ – This shall be the default selection, and display all Undertaking requirements regardless of their status. ‘Re-submit Requirement’ – Display all Undertaking requirements with the ‘Review Requirement’ status, i.e. requirements rejected from Lead Agency due to various reasons (e.g. incomplete information). CRO(Undertaking) shall be allow to re-submit their requirements upon completing the follow-up actions (e.g. include missing information in the earlier submission). ‘Submit Company Details’ – Display all requirements that are pending the agency’s action to fill in the allocated company details for submission of security clearance (template per MHA’s requirements). At the end of the relevant tabs, system shall show the number of pending requirements in amber to denote there are requirements that need CRO(Undertaking)’s action. No number shall be displayed when there is no pending requirement.
8.1.3 In displaying the Undertakings requirements, system shall show the following information a. Agency’s Reference Number b. Requesting Agency c. d. C-91

8.1.4 RFQ No. DEFNGPP7126100138 c. Lead Agency d. ACRA file) e. Services Required f. Status Allocated Company (show UEN and latest Company Name retrieved from g. Last Updated h. Last Updated by When CRO(Undertaking) sets quick filter to ‘All’, system shall provide a progress bar to show the status, e.g. ‘Re-submit Requirement’, ‘Submit Company Details’. ‘Status’ shall have an ‘info’ button. When CRO(Undertaking) mouse over the button, the system shall display the status tooltip.

8.1.5 CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to create new undertaking requirements and he/she shall fill in the following information (mandatory for all unless specify otherwise), a. Reference Number (fill in the agency internal reference number) b. Requesting Agency (select from the dropdown list) c. Approver Name (fill in the agency’s approver name) d. Approver Title (select from the dropdown list) e. Approval Date (fill in the date that agency’s obtained the approval to register this undertaking requirement or company) f. h. Lead Agency (select from the dropdown list) g. Services Required Preferred Company (optional - select from the dropdown list with search function using UEN or partial company name; SSIC of the company shall be auto-populated when a UEN is selected) CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to save the inputs as draft. He/She shall be able to retrieve the draft and continue to update it for final submission.

8.1.6 Upon clicking on ‘Submit’ for new undertaking requirements, a. If the preferred company is already an approved company/firm, system shall inform CRO(Undertaking) and state the company/firm is supporting the number of WOG agencies and inform that there are other companies with the same SSIC that might be suitable. System shall require CRO(Undertaking) to acknowledge the following before he/she could proceed to confirm the submission: b.  I am aware that [UEN] [Name of Company] selected in this submission will be a shared EF upon final approval of my registration request.  My agency will work with the shared EF to develop an E-Plan.

8.1.7 Once clicking on ‘Confirm’, system shall route the request to the selected Lead Agency for allocation. An email notification shall be sent to the relevant Lead Agency or Controller Undertakings to inform of a request pending his/her action. c. There shall be audit trail to record the acknowledgement and timestamp.

8.1.8 RFQ No. DEFNGPP7126100138 CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to modify, view and delete undertaking requirements submitted by his/her agency. Only requirements with process prior to Allocation can be modified or deleted while the rest are for view only. An email notification shall be sent to the relevant Lead Agency to inform of a request has been modified/deleted.

8.1.9 System shall send an email notification to the CRO(Undertaking) to inform him/her when a request is rejected by Lead Agency. He/She shall be able to view the case and the reasons for rejection. He/She shall be able to update/rectify the rejected requirements and re-submit it to the Lead Agency, including selecting another Lead Agency. An email notification shall be sent to the relevant Lead Agency users to inform of a request pending his/her action.

8.1.10 For shared firms, at the allocation/approval stage, the Lead Agency/Controller Undertakings shall be able to assign a co-ordinating agency who will co- ordinate/oversee a combined E-Plan. The co-ordinating agency is an optional field.

8.1.11 For allocated undertaking requirements, CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to enter the company details for submission of security clearance (template per MHA’s requirements). He/She shall be able to upload documents (pdf, word, excel, etc) when submitting for security clearance. Upon clicking on ‘Submit’ for submission of security clearance, system shall route the request to MHA Office for processing.
8.1.12 An email notification shall be sent to the MHA Officer to inform of a request pending his/her action.

8.1.13 System shall send an email notification to CRO(Undertaking) after MHA Office updates in CRIPS the outcome of the security clearance. If it is successful, an email notification shall be sent to Controller Undertakings to inform him/her to approve the undertakings requirements. If it is unsuccessful, an email notification shall be sent to the relevant Lead Agency and CRO(Undertaking). If the case requires CRO(Undertaking)’s follow-up, he/she shall be able to update the information and re-submit the case to MHA Office for security clearance. If the case requires Lead Agency’s follow-up, he/she shall be able to reallocate the request to another company and CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to submit the request for security clearance after updating the relevant information.

8.1.14 Upon successfully clearance by MHA Office, the request shall be routed to Controller Undertakings for his/her approval. Of note, MHA Office may indicate an expiry date for the security clearance. a. If MHA Office indicate the expiry date as “31-12-9999”, it means no expiry date. b. For other dates, CRO(Undertaking) shall initiate security re-clearance at least 2 months before the security clearance expiry date. c. System shall have a workflow to allow CRO(Undertaking) to submit for security re-clearance. The re-clearance requests could be due to changes in the firm’s senior management or expiry set by MHA Office. d. Expiry and security re-clearance shall not reset the processes performed upon MHA Office’s first security clearance.

title: Manage Firms Information
acceptance_criteria: 8.2.1 System shall have flexibility such that CRO(Undertaking) can manage the firm’s information without having to de-register and re-register the firm.

8.2.2 For undertakings registered by my agency, system shall allow CRO(Undertaking) to edit and view information of the company, e.g. a. The company’s Point of Contact b. Internal comments (any notes about the company)
8.2.3 For allocated or approved firms, CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to update selected information, e.g. addresses, contact details, etc.

8.2.4 When displaying the firm’s name on screen or in generated reports, system shall use the firm’s UEN to retrieve the most updated company name based on ACRA data that is also stored in CRIPS. SSIC of the company shall also be displayed.

8.2.5 For undertakings registered by an agency, system shall allow the CRO(Undertaking) of that particular agency to de-register companies that have been allocated by Lead Agency or have been approved by Controller Undertakings. An email notification shall be sent to Controller Undertakings to inform of the de-registration request pending his/her action.
8.2.6 The system shall send an email notification to CRO(Undertaking) to inform him/her that Controller Undertakings has deallocated the firm.

8.2.7 CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to re-submit security clearance should the approved EF has senior management changes. The re-submission shall be routed to MHA Office for processing, including an email notification to inform MHA Office that there are re-submission requests and require their actions.
